story_text.page_8: Green felt soft like grass. Blue was cool like a gentle breeze. And purple... purple felt like the coziest hug.
story_text.page_9: At the end of the bridge, they found Dreamland—a magical place where cotton candy clouds floated past castles made of moonbeams.
story_text.page_10: "You can dream of anything here," Stardust whispered. Lily closed her eyes and dreamed of flying through fields of flowers.
story_text.page_11: When it was time to go home, Stardust carried Lily gently back across the Rainbow Bridge. The colors now shimmered with sleepy magic.
story_text.page_12: "Will you come back tomorrow?" Lily yawned. "I'll be here whenever you need me," Stardust promised. "Just look for the rainbow."
story_text.page_13: Lily climbed back into her cozy bed, feeling warm and safe. She hugged her pillow and smiled.
story_text.page_14:
And as she drifted off to sleep, she could still see the soft glow of the Rainbow Bridge... and a unicorn dancing among the stars.

The End
